53e1cfaad5e0566e4ea1.headline: Spain outlines plans for AI cooperation before regional summit
53e1cfaad5e0566e4ea1.summary: Spain says countries are working on AI together ahead of the Ibero-American Summit. Plans cover shared access to data, AI tools for local languages and computer power.
body_paragraphs: Ministers have agreed to create an Ibero-American AI alliance. It would help countries share good-quality data, build AI tools suited to their languages and needs, and pool computer power for researchers, public services and businesses.
Spain’s announcement says this work should put people first. It calls for closing gaps in access to digital technology and protecting children, teenagers and people in vulnerable situations.

eefc381d2bfb99dc1716.headline: Sweden joins European talks on AI and society
eefc381d2bfb99dc1716.summary: Sweden says its prime minister will attend European meetings in Dublin. Leaders plan to discuss how AI could affect European businesses and society.

3090da02f395b8809131.headline: Slovenia sets up a council to advise on AI
3090da02f395b8809131.summary: Slovenia says it has created a 48-member council on AI and digital services. The group will advise the prime minister on developing and using AI.

2e8803a578995adb3b60.headline: Spain warns about fake sexual images made with AI
2e8803a578995adb3b60.summary: Spain has presented a campaign about AI-made sexual images shared without consent. The government calls this violence against women and urges people to take responsibility for what they share.

45c2e6222fa2bcdee437.headline: Estonia calls for stronger and safer European AI
45c2e6222fa2bcdee437.summary: Estonia says European leaders will discuss how to build more AI in Europe and use it safely. Its prime minister calls for AI that people can trust and control.

24fdfa2b534e112c3d66.headline: Moldova discusses AI projects with the World Bank
24fdfa2b534e112c3d66.summary: Moldova says its prime minister discussed possible AI projects with the World Bank. The talks covered using new technology to help people get work done and testing new ideas in Moldova.

13446e75e78b5701a66c.headline: White House links AI data centres to its infrastructure plans
13446e75e78b5701a66c.summary: The White House says it is investing in data centres for advanced AI. It says technology companies have agreed to pay for the extra power and grid upgrades their centres need, instead of passing those costs to households.

6857c69aceb6a6926df6.headline: UK plans to make AI a priority at the G20
6857c69aceb6a6926df6.summary: The UK says its prime minister discussed AI benefits and risks with France’s president. It plans to put AI high on the agenda during its 2027 G20 presidency and work on shared international standards.

7b902390cebc0f5d1039.headline: Estonia proposes a way to identify AI agents
7b902390cebc0f5d1039.summary: Estonia has put a draft law on its agenda to give AI agents a code linked to the person they act for. The code would show when an AI system is acting on someone’s behalf.
body_paragraphs: The government says the code would help make those actions more transparent, secure and accountable. This is a proposal, not a rule already in force.

21c715fcacb767b80ea4.headline: Croatia joins talks on AI and Europe’s economy
21c715fcacb767b80ea4.summary: Croatia says European leaders will discuss how AI could affect Europe’s economy and opportunities for growth at a meeting in Dublin.

cf3d6323a26683635404.headline: Denmark puts AI high on European leaders’ agenda
cf3d6323a26683635404.summary: Denmark says AI is at the top of the agenda for an informal meeting of European Union leaders in Dublin. Its prime minister is due to attend.

a96a39fbd0e8d7c460b7.headline: Estonia reviews AI use in ambulance and family doctor software
a96a39fbd0e8d7c460b7.summary: Estonia’s government heard a briefing on AI being introduced to ambulance and family doctor software. It also discussed a draft code to identify AI agents acting for people.
body_paragraphs: The proposed code would be linked to a person, so it would be clear when an AI agent acts on that person’s behalf. The healthcare briefing concerned the eKiirabi and PAI software systems.

d1c9f78c8bfc011634f1.headline: Andorra funds projects using AI for drones and local language tools
d1c9f78c8bfc011634f1.summary: Andorra says its business agency awarded €1 million across 10 research projects. Several use AI, including drones that inspect ski facilities and a tool designed to work in Catalan.
body_paragraphs: One project would use AI to guide drones and spot possible problems in images. Another aims to match firms with students and training providers. The Catalan-language tool is being developed for translation, legal advice and business paperwork.

da239373635d2d24ab50.headline: Moldova plans a data centre to support AI work
da239373635d2d24ab50.summary: Moldova says it is preparing a secure data centre that could support AI work and online public services. Its prime minister also called for using AI to help defend government systems from cyberattacks.
body_paragraphs: The data centre is being planned with support from the European Commission and Sweden’s development finance agency. The government says it would provide secure storage and support future AI capabilities.

458ab440018a785baadd.headline: Kazakhstan opens a public service office with AI tools
458ab440018a785baadd.summary: Kazakhstan says a new public service office in Karaganda has opened with AI tools. It also offers free help so residents can learn to use online government services themselves.

a6f59cdfd85c6ba4c949.headline: North Macedonia backs a factory planning to use AI and robots
a6f59cdfd85c6ba4c949.summary: North Macedonia’s prime minister says the government will support a new factory in Ohrid that plans to use AI and robots. He urged future investors to use similar technology in production.

a43e7da9674e581e716f.headline: Czechia creates a government council on AI
a43e7da9674e581e716f.summary: Czechia’s government says it has created a council on AI. The prime minister will chair it, with industry and trade officials helping to run it.
body_paragraphs: The prime minister said Europe needs to compete in using AI and pay attention to safety. The industry and trade minister will be the council’s first deputy chair, and the government’s AI envoy its executive deputy chair.
